corrections.reason: The word split across lines 11-12 is ኀቲም (signet/seal ring, paired with ቀለበቱን). The 1st-order Fidel ኀ was misread as ሖ.
Both visually (the bottom loop of the Ethiopic numeral ፵ = 40) and biblically (Pharaoh's elevation of Joseph is in Genesis 41:40-45), the numeral is ፵ rather than ፴.
